title: check-branding surfaces
description: Validates that product name and assets are consistent across six source files.
signature: Checks index.html, splash.html, kaava.toml, tauri.conf.json, and bundle icons
returns: list of surface locations and expected values
errors: Reports each surface that disagrees with branding.toml
semantics: Ensures every reference to the product name and asset paths matches branding.toml single source of truth.
